# Beben Design

> Beben Design is a design-led digital product studio based in Nairobi, Kenya, specializing in UX research, UI design, brand identity, front-end development, and digital product strategy. The studio treats design as research-backed problem-solving rather than decoration: every engagement starts with understanding user behaviour before any visual or code work begins.

Capabilities span brand identity and visual design, UX research, UI design for web/mobile/desktop, human-machine interfaces (HMI) for hardware-driven products, posters and corporate print, and front-end development in HTML/CSS, React, Webflow, Node.js, and WordPress. The studio serves clients across e-commerce, automotive, healthcare, recreation, real estate, retail, and agriculture, and works as full studio lead, team augmentation, or long-term partner. The Foundations package starts at $99 USD, a simple static site for startups, new businesses and campaigns getting established; larger engagements scale with scope via fixed-price, line-item quotes (no hourly billing). The studio is based in Westlands, Nairobi, and is reachable directly via WhatsApp or email, with no sales layer.

## Services

- [Brand Identity & Visual Design](https://beben.design/services/brand-identity/): Logo systems (primary, secondary, monochrome, favicon-optimised), structured brand guides, WCAG-compliant colour systems, typography hierarchy, and optional motion branding.
- [UX Research & Design](https://beben.design/services/ux-research/): User interviews, journey mapping, information architecture, low-fidelity wireframes, clickable prototypes, and usability testing measured against SUS scores and task-completion data.
- [UI Design & Component Systems](https://beben.design/services/ui-design/): Atomic, developer-ready UI kits in Figma with full component states, WCAG AA accessibility annotations, and developer handoff specs.
- [Digital Strategy & Product Planning](https://beben.design/services/digital-strategy/): MVP feature prioritisation, phased technical roadmaps, competitor UX benchmarking, and discovery workshops for early-stage concepts.
- [Migration & Rebuild](https://beben.design/services/migration-rebuild/): Audit, content inventory, an explicit kill list, then a rebuild you own outright. Redirects from every retired URL so search rankings move with you. Inherited content, not inherited code.
- [How we work](https://beben.design/services/how-we-work/): Running costs published and itemised, what the client owns and when, what a pivot costs, and the support tiers (Care, Care + credits, On request, Wind-down). Defines the line between a content update and a structural change.

## Tools

- [Free Web Tools](https://beben.design/tools/): A growing collection of single-purpose, browser-native utilities: no accounts, no server calls, no data collection. Every tool is downloadable as a standalone HTML file that runs offline forever.
- [Beben Arcade](https://beben.design/games/): Twelve tiny 8-bit games. Add it to your home screen, play offline, beat your best. No ads, ever.
- [QR Code Generator](https://beben.design/qr-code-generator/): Paste any URL, text, or contact info and get a clean, downloadable QR code instantly. No watermarks.
- [Contrast Grid](https://beben.design/contrast-grid/): Paste a whole palette, get every foreground and background pair scored against WCAG AA and AAA at once.
- [Dither Machine](https://beben.design/dither-machine/): Drop an image and push it through Atkinson, Floyd-Steinberg, or ordered Bayer dithering. Export the PNG.
- [Does It Fit?](https://beben.design/character-counter/): One text box, checked live against every limit that matters: title tags, meta descriptions, posts, subject lines.
- In development: Colour Blindness Simulator, SVG Cleaner, Favicon Forge, Fluid Type Calculator, EXIF Viewer and Stripper, JWT Decoder, Checksum Verifier, Text Diff, Passphrase Generator, Invoice Builder, Freelance Rate Calculator, Screenshot Framer, Barcode Generator.
